testing/report#

Test reports as text: for people, TAP, JSON or JUnit XML.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

HumanTestReport(origin: report, width: 80).string();
TapTestReport(report).string();
JUnitTestReport(origin: report, suite: "std").string();

Description#

Test reports as text: for people, TAP, JSON or JUnit XML. okkama run -t writes them.

object JUnitTestReport#

object JUnitTestReport

JUnit has several consumer dialects. This profile uses a testsuite root, case-level capture properties and Base64 system-out/system-err. It preserves nanosecond durations without float formatting or invalid XML byte decoding.
